scope: Prevent silent loss of nondefault metadata on the synthesized canonical ACAD APPID during DXF output.
finding: The streaming writer emits ACAD with flags 0 and no metadata before the APPID callback. Previously it accepted a callback row with flags 16 and omitted the flag; the focused test reproduced the failure before the fix.
change: Refuse canonical ACAD rows containing nonzero flags, application data, XDATA, reactor handles or counts, an extension-dictionary handle, or unresolved APPID/LAYER references. Keep the ordinary empty canonical alias and its existing source-handle binding.
checks: Generated AC1009, AC1014 and AC1032 ASCII and Binary controls cover eight nondefault states.
For each control, destination bytes and caller state survive refusal; the same writer retries with default metadata and produces baseline-identical output.
Fresh readback confirms one ACAD APPID with flags 0 after retry.
The existing source-table identity test passes, including the fixed ACAD handle binding.
Focused CTest: libdxfrw_appid_table_allocation and libdxfrw_dxf_source_table_identities, 2/2 passed.
limitations: This prevents silent metadata loss; it does not implement preservation of nondefault ACAD APPID metadata.
These generated controls are not independent producer or consumer semantic qualification.
Other writer families and whole-document graph closure remain open.
